text:
Lena Morris: Hi everyone, accepted the org invite but having weird git auth issues. I can see private repos but `git push` fails with 403. Using HTTPS on Windows and it keeps asking for credentials for my personal account. :disappointed:

Carlos Vega: Welcome Lena! Two quick checks: 1) Did you authenticate SSO when accepting the invite? 2) Is the remote URL HTTPS or SSH? Run `git remote -v` to confirm.

Lena Morris: I did the SSO web flow when accepting. Remote is HTTPS: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-staging.git. When pushing it prompts Windows Credential Manager and it only offers my personal github creds.

people-ops: Hi Lena 44b3fb Often Windows credential helper caches the personal account. You can either switch to SSH or refresh the stored credentials. Steps: open Credential Manager > Windows Credentials > remove any github.com entries, then do a push and sign in with your work account.

Lena Morris: Tried removing creds and still got redirected to personal account login page. On the web UI I can open PRs and see repos. Push from command line still 403.

Carlos Vega: Another option is to authenticate with the GitHub CLI using the work account and let it configure credentials: 

```
# login with SSO and set work account
gh auth login --hostname github.com --web
# then when pushing, gh will set up the right credentials
```

Lena Morris: Ran `gh auth login` and selected the work account via browser. After that `git push` prompts for username/password one last time and succeeded. Thanks!

infra-bot: Note: if your local repo has remotes using your personal username (e.g., https://github.com/personal-user/repo.git) update origin to organization repo and confirm branch protection settings.

Lena Morris: One follow-up: the branch I pushed to is protected and my PR shows "maintainers can approve" but I don't have write access on that branch. Do new hires get write rights?

people-ops: Repo write access is granted by team membership. If your role should have write, tell us which repos/teams you need. Otherwise you can push to feature branches but not to protected branches. Which team are you on?

Lena Morris: I'm on data-platform. Need write access to model-staging and infra-deploy.

Carlos Vega: Added Lena to team: data-platform and grant: write for model-staging. infra-deploy requires infra team membership; ping @infra-leads if you need that. You should now be able to push feature branches and request reviews.

Lena Morris: Can confirm I can push branches and open PRs without the 403 now. One last tip: I had to remove old SSH keys and re-add my work key to GitHub because my laptop had a personal key that the agent offered first.

people-ops: Nice catch. Summary for others: if you see 403 or credential prompts after accepting invite: 1) verify SSO accepted, 2) clear OS credential helper entries, 3) use `gh auth login` or SSH, 4) ensure team membership for repo write access. If stuck, DM people-ops with your GitHub username and screenshots. Welcome to Redwood! :tada:
